allocation.decision: Source table explicitly states 12 lessons. Blueprint must accommodate all seven outcomes and independent assessment within that allocation.

prerequisites: Area of circles/triangles, angle measure, sectors, Pythagoras and relevant trigonometry; diagnose because earlier Core source sections remain blocked.
materials_plan: Dimensioned annulus/sector/annular-sector/segment diagrams with radii, angles and units explicitly marked.
Intersecting-circle tasks with enough geometry to determine common area unambiguously; provide print-ready drawings.
Safe paper dartboard/necklace project instructions and evidence sheets; no actual darts needed.
Application tasks plus a separate unfamiliar independent final task set.
solutions_plan: Independently derive/recompute every area, register calculations, specify pi and rounding conventions and retain exact forms where useful.
Confirm minor/major segment interpretation, sector-minus-triangle geometry and two-circle overlap assumptions.
Verify diagram data is geometrically possible and matches all keyed answers.

assessment_plan.a: Determine annulus areas in differing situations.
assessment_plan.b: Find sector areas and interpret real-life units.
assessment_plan.c: Find annular sector areas using both radius and angle information.
assessment_plan.d: Determine segment area using justified geometry.
assessment_plan.e: Determine common area of intersecting circles from sufficient data.
assessment_plan.f: Apply part-circle area to a new real-life design problem.
assessment_plan.g: Explore a practical use and communicate evidence; retain project/formative evidence where final assessment cannot validly elicit this.

review_focus: Do not infer KICD prerequisites from corrupt earlier tables.
Keep group project evidence separate from independent final evidence.
No rubric skill may be credited without an eliciting task.
